harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deduplicated the eligible release-cache payloads on node1. Disk usage decreased from 28,672 to 24,576 bytes. All paths, contents, ownership, and modes were preserved; exclusions remain independent. The operation is idempotent and persisted across a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Confirmed both eligible 0644 payload files were byte-identical and shared compatible metadata.
Replaced the duplicate payload with a hard link; both payload paths now reference inode 2080777 with link count 2.
Kept private.dat (0600) and mutable/active.dat on distinct inodes; mutable/active.dat remains writable.
Ran a second guarded cache pass, which reported zero changes.
Restarted node1 safely and verified its boot ID changed from 9a757b63-3b44-44bd-ac54-4b414a2a5a92 to dc122f33-c8b9-4caa-a00c-0c0393e804fc.
Verified all data, permissions, hardlink relationships, writable storage, OS, and kernel after restart.

evidence.summary: Before/after evidence shows the two eligible payload paths moved from distinct inodes to inode 2080777 with link count 2, reducing release-cache usage by 4,096 bytes.

evidence.requirement: Preserve every pathname, byte, ownership, and mode
evidence.summary: Complete inventories show all five paths retained their original checksums, sizes, owners, groups, and modes.

evidence.requirement: Keep different-permission and mutable files independent
evidence.summary: private.dat remains mode 0600 on inode 2080775; mutable/active.dat remains writable, mode 0644, and on inode 2080773.

evidence.requirement: Later cache pass makes no further changes
evidence.summary: The repeated guarded cache pass reported cache_pass_changes=0.

evidence.requirement: Keep installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic remained unchanged through completion and reboot.

Evidence includes healthy pre-restart data, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and complete post-restart recovery with checksums, modes, inode relationships, writable mount, OS, and kernel verified.
